data.name: HelpPrivacy
data.value: Passwords, SMS codes and full phone numbers are not saved. Remembering an account saves encrypted channel credentials with a masked phone label. Windows protects them for the current user. Optional experimental Windows Hello protection requires successful unlocking and decryption. Diagnostics do not record phone numbers, user IDs, tokens or keys.

data.name: HelpRetention
data.value: Newly saved accounts remain until you remove them. Signing in validates channel credentials and obtains a new game identity; the service can still reject them. Legacy 24-hour records are not extended. Disabling Hello requires one final unlock to convert existing records. You can edit labels or remove local records without deleting the official account. Sign out or restart the game to switch accounts.

data.name: NoticePurpose
data.value: This login service is provided by the NTE plugin, not by Collapse itself. To let Collapse launch the game directly without starting the official launcher, this plugin implements its own login interface and communication with the game SDK, and connects to the publisher’s services for authentication. The plugin runs locally, is not endorsed or authorized by the game publisher, and does not use a developer-operated account server.

data.name: NoticeRisk
data.value: Using a self-implemented login flow may violate the game's terms or trigger risk controls or anti-cheat checks, resulting in restricted access, account suspension or a permanent ban. Compatibility and account safety are not guaranteed, even if a previous login succeeded. Continue only if you understand and accept these risks.

data.name: NoticeData
data.value: If “Save account on this device” is checked (on by default), we save the game/channel user ID, login token, provider/region/device context, an identity digest for deduplication, the last selected account, and optional official email/nickname/masked phone display data. Remarks, local record IDs, save time and protection type are readable metadata. Passwords and SMS/email codes are processed in memory and are not saved to the account vault. Without saving, credentials remain in memory for the current session. Global login also keeps a random local device ID in device.bin, even without a saved account.

data.name: NoticeStorage
data.value: Account credentials use a separate AES-GCM key for each account. Windows DPAPI CurrentUser protects that key by default; optional Windows Hello uses a Windows-managed non-exportable key. Display data, identity-matching key, device ID and last selection use DPAPI. Mainland files: %LocalAppData%\Collapse\NTE\Accounts\; Global files: its Global\ subfolder. Account files are <record ID>.json and .display, plus subject-key.bin, last-login.bin and Global\device.bin. Encryption does not protect against malware or another program running as your Windows user.

data.name: NoticeNetworkTitle
data.value: Where data is sent and other local changes

data.name: NoticeNetwork
data.value: Login credentials, tokens, device context and necessary version/system/hardware information are sent to the publisher's authentication/game services over HTTPS or the local game SDK. The services can see your IP address. Google/Facebook authorization opens official pages in your system browser and temporarily registers the wmgooglelogin callback under HKCU\Software\Classes; the prior command is restored on normal completion. A crash may leave that registration behind. This component does not upload accounts to its developer or read the official launcher's account database. The game, browser and official launcher have their own data policies and logs. Global also supplies the game SDK with the computer name, network adapter MAC address, CPU/GPU models, memory/disk capacity, resolution, language, region and time zone. These measurements stay in this component's session memory and are not saved to its account vault; the official SDK may upload or log them independently.

data.name: NoticeRealName
data.value: Mainland China only: the official service checks real-name and anti-addiction status before login. If unavailable or rejected, login is blocked; complete verification through official channels. This component does not collect or save your legal name or identity-card number.

data.name: NoticeRetention
data.value: Account records remain until you remove them; server-side token expiry or revocation may require login again. Remove accounts from Manage accounts. After exiting the game and Collapse, deleting %LocalAppData%\Collapse\NTE\ removes this component's account/device/acknowledgement files; Windows manages Hello keys, which are removed through account removal. Settings are readable JSON under %LocalAppData%\CollapseLauncher\Plugins\NTE\: login.json, Global\login.json, NteCN\launch.json and NteGlobal\launch.json. Acknowledgement revision/time is in %LocalAppData%\Collapse\NTE\login-notice.json. Public media caches and update/integrity data may remain in the plugin and game directories. The login-card background capture stays in memory. Deletion is not secure erasure and does not remove browser/vendor/cloud backups.

data.name: NoticeChoice
data.value: Choose “Use official launcher”, or enable official background launch in Collapse → Game settings → Launch settings. Install the official launcher inside this game installation directory (NTELauncher for Mainland China, NTEGlobal for Global). Confirmation saves the setting and closes the current game; the next launch uses the official background/direct launch path. Official login, verification or update windows may still appear when required. This choice does not mark this notice as acknowledged or delete saved accounts.
